item.title: SEC Proposes Expanding Securities Eligible for Cross Trading by Registered Funds
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission today proposed amendments to the Investment Company Act “cross-trading rule,” which permits transactions in securities between a registered fund and its affiliates under certain conditions. The proposed amendments…
